newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM-Kymmene sees end-yr like May-Aug.
newsitem.headline: UPM-Kymmene sees end-yr like May-Aug.

text.p: Finland's largest forestry group UPM-Kymmene Oy said on Thursday it expected its profitability towards the end of the year to be around May-August levels.

"Because of the fall in sales prices and under-utilisation of manufacturing capacity, UPM-Kymmene expects profitability during the remainder of the year to be about the same as that for the four months to August," the company said in a statement with its results.
"Market pulp prices are still difficult to predict," it said.
It said prices for fine papers, which are dependent on market pulp prices, had been raised in September-October.
"Improved demand is anticipated for printing and writing papers during the final part of the year, with the capacity utilisation rate higher than at the beginning of the year," UPM-Kymmene said.
"Sales prices will be lower than for the early part of this year and the last four months of 1995," it said.
"Paper stocks held by customers and distributors are believed to have returned to normal levels," it added.
"Economic growth is forecast to strengthen gradually in Europe, the group's main market, and this will increase paper consumption," it said.
Demand for packaging materials and special products was expected to remain good, UPM-Kymmene said.
UPM-Kymmene said in June it expected profitability in the rest of the year to be poorer than in January-April.
